vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: wechat-mp-fetch
Version: 1.1.0

The skill is a legitimate utility for extracting text content from WeChat Official Account articles using Playwright. The code in `scripts/wx-article-fetch.js` performs basic URL validation, uses a headless browser to render the page, and extracts specific DOM elements (#js_content) without any evidence of data exfiltration, obfuscation, or unauthorized system access.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and dependencies align with its stated purpose (fetching WeChat mp articles with Playwright); it requires no credentials and does not exhibit incoherent or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: Name/description: WeChat article fetcher. Declared files and package.json add Playwright and a single script that opens a Chromium browser, renders the mp.weixin.qq.com page, extracts title/content, and prints JSON. Requiring Playwright/Chromium is proportionate to the stated goal.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs local npm install and running the provided node script with a single URL. The runtime script only reads process.argv[2], navigates to the page, waits for selectors, extracts text, and prints JSON. It does not read other files, env vars, or send data to external endpoints beyond fetching the page content itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is instruction-only in the registry (no automated install spec), but SKILL.md tells users to run 'npm install' and 'npx playwright install chromium'. That will download Playwright and then download Chromium binaries from Playwright's browser distribution host — a network download of a large browser binary is expected for this tool. package-lock references registry.npmmirror.com (an npm mirror), which is plausible but different from the official registry; this is not inherently malicious but worth noting if you require packages only from the official registry.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials and the code does not access environment variables or secret files. No disproportionate credential or config access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request 'always' presence, does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings, and does not persist credentials. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default for skills but is not combined here with other concerning privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it runs a local headless Chromium (via Playwright) to render mp.weixin.qq.com pages and extract title/content. Before installing, verify you trust the source (check the referenced GitHub repo), ensure you have Node >=18 (Playwright requires it), and be aware that 'npx playwright install chromium' will download a browser binary. Run the tool in a sandboxed environment if you are concerned about fetching untrusted URLs (the headless browser will execute page JS and make network requests). Do not pass URLs that include sensitive tokens or rely on your logged-in browser session—the script does not perform logins and will not access your browser cookies. If you require use of only official package registries, consider auditing package-lock or installing from your preferred registry.
